About John Crawford Company

We help you choose window treatments with the fit, the light and the way you'll use them in mind. Visit our Woodland Hills showroom to compare options and talk through your ideas.

Talk with JohnVisit the showroom

John started with installation.

John came into window coverings by helping with an installation in the mid-1980s. He went on to work in vertical-blind production, where he wrote software for work orders and cutting labels.

He later moved to California, started his own business and opened a retail store in 1995. That hands-on background still shapes the advice we give, from how a shade will sit in the window to how drapery will move on its track.

Talk it through with John.

You might have a particular shade in mind, or you might just want less afternoon glare. We can help you compare fabrics, finishes, light control and operating options, including Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments.

Our work includes measuring, installation and showing you how the controls operate. If a product is delayed or goes on backorder, we keep you informed. And when you have a question after installation, you can still call us.

Explore window shades

One window is a good place to start.

Early in his career in upstate New York, John drove about an hour to help a customer who needed one mini blind for her bathroom. That small job led to a referral for a whole house of blinds.

John still welcomes one-window jobs. Whether you're thinking about one room or several, we're happy to talk.

Bring your ideas.

You don't need to have a product picked out. Schedule a visit to see fabrics and finishes in person at our Woodland Hills showroom, and talk with us about what you'd like to change.
